observations.area: Phase 6b baked calldata vs local-pass R
observations.text: R (DOLA delivered by the minter's totalWithdrawal execute) is computed in forge's LOCAL pass as OWNER's simulated balance delta, and `DOLA.approve(minter, r)` + `minter.noMintDeposit(sdolaStrategy, DOLA, r)` are broadcast with that baked r under --skip-simulation --slow --ledger (Phase 6b is ~tx 50+ of a multi-hour session). The mined execute redeems pro-rata of LIVE shares at the LIVE autoDOLA price, and organic DOLA mints landing on-chain before the setStablecoinEnabled(false) tx increase the minter principal, so R_mined != R_sim. R_mined < R_sim -> noMintDeposit transferFrom reverts (halt b: collateral on the OWNER EOA). R_mined > R_sim -> the excess DOLA silently stays on OWNER; the `OWNER DOLA back to pre-execution level` require is a local-pass check only, and verifier `_doneMinterReseeded` only lower-bounds principal against the recorded (simulated) R. Same failure class as script/archives/MigrateSaga2Rescue.s.sol's documented baked-amount revert and prior MR-22 ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast. Resume path re-derives R on chain, first-run path does not.

Re-initiate path: if the minter execution window lapses after Phase 1 (V1 paused) and before Phase 7 (V2 unpaused), both stakers stay paused for the remaining expiry wait (up to 78h after initiate) + 6h new waiting period; if it lapses after 6b step (a), DOLA phUSD minting is also disabled for that period. Documented as a halt remedy, but the operational blast radius (all V1/V2 staker funds frozen for up to ~84h) is not stated.

registerStablecoin resets mintedToday = 0 and lastMintTimestamp = 0 besides maxMintPerDay/enabled. The script restores maxMintPerDay and enabled but the rolling 24h mint window is reset, granting a fresh full 4000e18 daily allowance immediately regardless of same-day DOLA mints. Story 092 text says 'clears mint-window state' (known); not asserted/restored.

At block 25990689 the only YS_DOLA clients are V1 and the minter (totalDeposited == sum). Phase 6's relinquishPrincipalAsOwner(V1, surplus ~26.9 DOLA) writes down principal without touching shares, and the minter's accrued yield (~11.4 DOLA) plus V1's residual yield are all captured by the minter's pro-rata execute (R > P, 'not a loss', no upper bound) and re-seeded as MINTER PRINCIPAL on the sDOLA strategy - removing ~39 DOLA from SYA-skimmable surplus and from the V1 set-aside buffer (recipient V1, 10%). Value-routing side effect, not a loss (cf. memory: externally-derived yield = opportunity cost).

observations.area: pre-broadcast preview cannot run before initiate+6h
observations.text: Phase 0 always runs _phase0_minterWithdrawalWindow (no preview bypass), so :preview against live mainnet reverts until story-090 initiate has landed >= 6h earlier. The operator commits the 78h clock before the first live full-cutover preview; only fork tests (warp) rehearse Phase 3b/6b earlier. Initiation itself moves nothing and is re-initiable, so this is ordering coupling rather than risk of loss.

(i) story 092 says skip the Phase-0 window check once source principal is 0 AND the repoint is done; implementation skips on principal == 0 alone. (ii) story step order register -> approveYS -> re-seed; implementation re-seeds before registerStablecoin (documented rationale). (iii) story says DOLA.forceApprove(minter, R); OWNER already holds type(uint256).max DOLA allowance to the minter, which the script zeroes then sets to R (net effect: the standing infinite approval is removed).
All of 082-092 sit in state folder 'auto-complete' (not in storyPolicy's state list); 090's completion block says 'machine approval - not human-reviewed'.

Ledger e6e1f293 (pps35l11) is wont-fix with triageReason 'L-11 is expected so we'll just have to respond to crises in the moment. That's the purpose of 72 hours.' yet story 096 (d0722f6/a2b9d75/bff40f3) implemented the audit's PREFERRED mitigation (resume past Phase 6 defers 6b and unpauses V2). Code now contradicts the ledger disposition; human must decide whether to flip to fixed. New code paths (minterMovePending, v2LiveBeforeMinterMove verifier relaxation) are new attack/footgun surface in scope for script-auditor.

(i) Deferral also triggers when the window is open but < WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN left, or still in 6h wait, or None (Decision 3). (ii) _resumePastPhase6 = migrator identity + all V1 pools Migrating + V1 principal 0 on every source; halt INSIDE Phase 6 still hard-fails (stakers frozen in paused V1). (iii) v2LiveBeforeMinterMove is read from the operator-controlled progress file and relaxes two live verifier checks (disclosed risk). (iv) While pending, SYA keeps skimming YS_DOLA, autoAnnihilateAvailable(DOLA) true but autoAnnihilate(DOLA) reverts.

Runbook/NatSpec say the lapsed-window :broadcast tail 'stops at :verify' and that that chained :verify runs the live V2 per-user checks. But the tail is forge && patch-mainnet-addresses-stable-staker-v2.js && :verify; the patch script exits 2 for any deploymentStatus != 'completed' (awaiting_minter_window included), so :verify is NOT chained on the pending path. The 'first pending-state verify immediately after V2 went live' - the only place the live balance checks run on this path - depends on the operator running :verify manually. script-auditor should confirm (fork: status awaiting_minter_window -> node patch script exit code). Confirmed statically: scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-stable-staker-v2.js L84-85 fail(2) for any status != 'completed', with no awaiting_minter_window branch. Side effect: on the pending path StableStakerV2/Antimatter/YieldStrategyDola are NOT patched into mainnet-addresses.ts even though V2 is live for >= 6h+.
